### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8644ce711d3fddc4392498ee8bec43bd30685f5a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

Browser readings for #36593, taken against a running app at head 2b334bf1.

Stack: the showcase app, a fresh database on its own port (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`), and the Console served by Vite from this branch's `ui/` source. Record: a `showcase_client_brief` created with only `title` and `summary`, so its declared group 「Internal Only」 (`internal_notes`, `deal_value`) is all empty. Read mode, the default record page. Chromium driven by Playwright at 390x844 (phone) and 1440x900 (desktop). "Before" is the same stack with `DetailSection.tsx` restored to `origin/main` 4c93f880; it was put back afterwards (`git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, blob equal to `HEAD`).

| Viewport | Build | Row before press | Internal Only drawn before press | Row after press | Internal Only heading, Internal Notes, Deal Value after press |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| phone 390 | main 4c93f880 | Show 1 empty field (count 1) | no | Hide empty fields | no, no, no |
| phone 390 | this PR | Show 3 empty fields (count 3) | no | Hide empty fields | yes, yes, yes |
| desktop 1440 | main 4c93f880 | Show 1 empty field (count 1) | no | Hide empty fields | no, no, no |
| desktop 1440 | this PR | Show 3 empty fields (count 3) | no | Hide empty fields | yes, yes, yes |

The one empty field main counts is `project`. This PR counts it plus the two fields of 「Internal Only」. Before the press, the page draws the same in both builds: 「Client Brief」, 「System information」 and the row, with nothing of 「Internal Only」. After the press on this PR, 「Internal Only」 draws in its place under the filled group, with its heading and the rows "Set Internal Notes" and "Set Deal Value". Screenshots (8 PNG) are kept with the dev's report, not committed.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2b334bf152a366fb3268b037c630629330fd032f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx

Read for this record: card #36593 and its four comments (triage 7089103708, claim 7118520763, round-1 report 7118896943, claim amendment 7118947910), the PR body, PR comments 7120468028 and 7120948803, the net diff `4c93f880..2b334bf1` (6 files), and the 70 check-runs on the head (61 success, 9 skipped, 0 failure). The rest of the diff (the two test files, the changeset, the regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: unchanged, and declared so. `hideEmpty` on the `record:details` section entry is still `z.boolean().optional()`; only the `describe()` string and a TSDoc paragraph moved. Right.
- Public types and exports: none added, removed or renamed. Right.
- Generated reference: `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` row 1768 carries the new describe verbatim; `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Spec property liveness` are green on the head. Right.
- Rendered behaviour, field list (default record page under `RecordPageColumns`): an all-empty section with `hideEmpty` resolved to `true` is now reported to the list's tally and drawn once `fieldList.showEmpty` is on. Declared, and matches the tree (`readerShowsEmpty`, and `useReportEmptyFields` without the `!hideAllEmptySection` term). Right.
- Rendered behaviour, outside the field list: the same section now also draws when the per-object `showEmptyFields` choice is on. Declared for `record:details`. Not declared: `DetailView` hands `objectName` to the same `DetailSection` (four call sites), so an authored `hideEmpty: true` on a `detail-view` section yields to that choice too under a host preference store. The `detail-section` node passes no `objectName`, so it is unchanged. The declaration is incomplete by that one surface.
- Print and edit mode: unchanged, as declared. `readerShowsEmpty` is false on a print page, and `!isEditing` was already there.

### ② Semver level

`Metadata-protocol: semantic` is the right kind: no key, value or default moves, and the read-mode meaning of an accepted value does. `semantic` takes at least `minor` on each package the diff moves, and the changeset carries `@objectstack/spec: minor` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail: minor`, the two packages the diff moves. `Clause-②: no` is right: no accept-set or public-type change. Both lines are in the PR body and in the changeset body, and `Check Changeset` is green.

The changeset body under-states the reach by the `detail-view` surface named in ①. If the fix for S1 edits `@object-ui/types`, that package needs its own line in the changeset.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Round-1 open question (where the fix goes, options A, B, C): answered by the claim amendment 7118947910, a seat route to a narrowed C. The tree implements that route and nothing wider: no default flips in `record-details.tsx`, and nothing is written into the default page's group references.
- The route is a seat call on a `semantic` change to an authored key, and the round-1 report had marked option C as needing a maintainer decision. It reverses two shipped pins and one sentence of the still-pending changeset `.changeset/36147-record-field-list.md` ("An authored `hideEmpty` group stays hidden and is not counted"). The maintainer ruling 7066516044 on #36147, item 4, rules one row at the end of the field area and does not rule on an authored hide, so no ruling is contradicted. Escalated to the seat as a visibility point, not a blocker: the PR's maintainer digest names only declared groups, and should also say that an authored `hideEmpty: true` now yields to the reader.
- Dev flag, strip fallback (`EmptySectionsLine` does not name or count a `hideEmpty: true` section): accepted as out of scope. The route forbids changing the toggle-off page, and `EmptySectionsFold.tsx` is not in the diff.
- Dev flag, the plugin-detail `inputs` description and `record.mdx`: not accepted as out of scope. See S1.
- Dev deviations (PR opened after local verification, screenshots kept off GitHub, AGENTS.md read at round 2): no effect on the contract.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff is render logic and prose; it adds no query, id materialisation or in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, against the route and its first consumer (`record-details.tsx` resolves `s.hideEmpty ?? true`, then `DetailSection`):

- "It is hidden while the reader hides empty fields": holds. `hideAllEmptySection` now requires `!readerShowsEmpty`.
- "its empty fields are counted by the empty-fields toggle that ends the record page's field list": holds. The section reports `emptyCount` whenever it folds into the list and is not editing.
- "the same for an authored `true` and the default": holds. `DetailSection` sees only the resolved `true`. This also keeps `true` and an omitted key meaning the same, which the describe's "renderer default: on" requires and option A would have broken.
- "a print page keeps it hidden": holds, and `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` line 97 stays true.
- The TSDoc paragraph agrees with the describe and names the route as a seat route.

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`, tried against these cases:

- Field list, toggle off: section returns null and is counted. Toggle on: all fields draw. Pressed again: it leaves. Holds.
- Outside the field list with the per-object choice on: the section draws every field and its own "Hide empty fields" row (`foldAllEmptySection` turns on once the hide lets go), and pressing that row hides it again. Holds, and matches the flipped #25883 pin.
- Whole-body fold (`EmptySectionsFold`) and the closing line (`EmptySectionsLine`): neither counts the section, and both still draw it through `DetailSection` once the choice is on. No double count, no orphan heading.
- Hook order: no hook added or made conditional; the early return stays below every hook.
- Print: `foldsIntoList` is already false on a print page and `readerShowsEmpty` is forced false. Holds.

Findings:

S1 (should-fix) — the change in `DetailSection.tsx` makes published sentences about this same key false, and the PR leaves them. (a) The `record:details` `sections` input description in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` line 702 says an all-empty section "renders nothing at all — no heading, no skeleton" with no reader condition. It ships in the package's `dist`, in `sdui.manifest.json` line 1599, and in the generated `content/docs/ui/components/record.mdx` line 57. (b) `@object-ui/types` ships the same unconditional claim in the `DetailViewSection.hideEmpty` TSDoc (`ui/packages/types/src/views.ts`, which states it is "kept in agreement with the spec's own `describe()` text"), in `record-components.ts` line 224, and in the `views.zod.ts` describe "Hide an all-empty section entirely". After this PR each is false whenever the reader shows empty fields. #35019 moved the spec describe, the types docs and the component manifest in one PR; this change owes the same. The claim's file surface is the seat's to widen. Fix (a) in `index.tsx` and regenerate the manifest and `record.mdx`; fix (b) and add `@object-ui/types` to the changeset.

N1 (nit) — "showing empty fields draws the section in its place" does not hold on a body outside the field list when there is no host preference store or no object name. The choice is then per-section state, the hidden section draws no row of its own, and neither another section's row nor the closing line reaches it. The section stays hidden as on `main`. One clause in the describe would cover it; it can ride the S1 wording pass.

N2 (nit) — the describe and the changeset name `record:details` only, while an authored `hideEmpty: true` on a `detail-view` section yields the same way under a host store (① above). Say so in the changeset and in the types TSDoc that S1 edits.

N3 (nit) — the pending `.changeset/36147-record-field-list.md` still says an authored `hideEmpty` group stays hidden and is not counted, so the next release notes would compile both statements. One sentence in this PR's changeset saying it supersedes that line is enough.
